entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support! My name is Chloe. How can I help you today?
Hi Chloe. I'd like to start a return for an order I received a couple of weeks ago. The order number is VF-8675309.
Of course, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order... VF-8675309. I see it right here. It looks like you ordered a Pro-Series jersey and a VeloBand Pulse. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. I need to return both items. The fit on the jersey wasn't right, and the Pulse just isn't what I was looking for.

I understand. I'm looking at the delivery date, which was 17 days ago. Let's start with the jersey. That's no problem at all; it's well within our 90-day return window. I can email you a prepaid return label for that right now.
Okay, great. And what about the Pulse?
Regarding the VeloBand Pulse, I'm afraid that item isn't eligible for a return. I'm showing its delivery date was 17 days ago, and the Pulse has a strict 10-day return policy.
What? Ten days? That's ridiculous! Why would these two items have different rules? I bought them on the same order!

I completely understand your frustration, and I apologize if that wasn't made clear. We have separate policies for different product categories. Apparel, like the jersey, has our standard 90-day policy, but due to hygiene reasons and the electronic nature of the device, the VeloBand Pulse has that specific 10-day window.
That doesn't seem fair at all. I wouldn't have even opened it if I'd known that. So you're just not going to help me with half of my return?

I truly wish I could override the system, but I'm bound by the return policy on this one. However, I recognize that having separate policies for two items in the same box can be confusing. For the inconvenience and misunderstanding, I can issue a $25 VeloFit store credit to your account immediately.
A $25 credit? It's not a full refund, but... I guess that's something. So, I can still return the jersey for my money back, and you'll add a $25 credit to my account?

That is exactly right. You will get a full refund for the jersey once we receive it, and I've just applied that $25 credit to your account right now. The return label for the jersey is on its way to your email.
Okay. Well, thank you for doing that. I appreciate you finding a way to help. That makes things a bit better.
You're very welcome. It was my pleasure to find a resolution for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Chloe.
My pleasure! Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
